title: Paradise Kiss
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yukari, a pressured high school senior at an elite prep school, is recruited as a model by Paradise Kiss, four fashion students including the charismatic designer George. She skips cram school, falls into an intense romance with George, clashes with her mother and briefly runs away and drops out before reconciling. After the showcase the group disbands, and Yukari chooses her own modeling career over following George to Paris.
life_message: It holds up finding and choosing your own path, even when love and family pull in other directions.
